page.layout: One printed page; centred imprint in capitals in the middle of the page. Show-through text from the reverse faintly visible above and below, not transcribed.
page.notes: Title page imprint: Antwerp, Plantin press, widow and Johannes Moretus, 1594. The faint text above and below the imprint is show-through from the reverse and is not transcribed. A small brown mark lies below the imprint; no printed text there.
